No. 2397/68 - FRIDAY, AUGUST 16, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: KDS/AKU/4/2/1/102. Reference No. of Ministry of Tourism and Land :

4-3/18/2020/WS/81. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, (chapter 460) as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following Lots of land for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land to be acquired : 02 Lots of land situated within following boundaries and numbered 02 and 03 with a total extent of 0.0562 Hectare, named as Kinnarapelakumbura, depicted in the Cadastral plan No. K. C. 320668, surveyed, prepared and approved by the Surveyor General on 10.10.2023 and situated in Konakalagalavillage in No. 581 - Konakalagalavillage Officer’s Division in Akurana Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kandy District in the Central Province :

01. Lot No. 02 Name of Land: Kinnarapela Kumbura; Name & Address of the Claimant: K.P.D.K. Priyadarshani De Silva, No. 100, Sri Vijitha Mawatha, Konakalagala, Alawathugoda; Extent: 0.0370 Hectare. (14.6 Perches)
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

Boundaries : On North : Lot No. 01 and Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by G.N. Premawardana; On East : Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by G.N. Premawardana and Lot No. 04; On South : Lots No. 4, 3 and Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by K.P.D.K.P.D. Silva; On West : Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by K.P.D.K.P.D. Silva and Lot No. 01.

02. Lot No. 03 Name of Land: Kinnarapela Kumbura; Name & Address of the Claimant: K.P.D.K. Priyadarshani De Silva, No. 100, Sri Vijitha Mawatha, Konakalagala, Alawathugoda; Extent: 0.0132 Hectare. (5.2 Perches)

Boundaries : On North : Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by K.P.D.K.P.D. Silva, Lot No. 2 and 4; On East : Lot No. 02, 04 and stream (Dried); On South : Lots No. 4, stream (Dried) and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); On West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Kinnarapela Kumbura claimed by K.P.D.K.P.D. Silva.

All persons interested, having rights or possessions in the aforesaid Land are required to appear before me personally, or by an agent duly authorized in writing at Divisional Secretary’s Office of Akurana, on the 27th September, 2024, at 10.00 am.
2 A III යකොටව - ශ්‍රී ඼ංකා ප්‍රජාාාා්ත්‍රික වමාජාලාදී ජානරජායේ ි ව ශෙය඾඿ ගැවට් පත්‍රය - 2024.08.16 Part III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 16.08.2024

They are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of September, 2024, the nature of their interests and rights in the land and the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the aforesaid land, the amount of compensation and the details of the compensation of such amount.
D.R.K. Hennayaka, Divisional Secretary, Akurana. At Akurana Divisional Secretariat, 14th day of August, 2024. EOG 08 - 0201 THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
